quote: Entry to Khoo Kongsi is RM15 for adults... and children are RM1

quote: The main temple grounds are free to enter... inclined lift... Pagoda... charges around 2 MYR

quote: Adults (13-59 years): Normal Lane @ RM 40 or Express Lane @ RM 80 ... 6.30am - 11.00pm

claim: The Habitat on Penang Hill offers the Langur Way canopy walk and Curtis Crest tree-top walk.
quote: The Habitat Penang Hill

quote: The Curtis Crest Tree Top Walk will undergo maintenance works from 13 May 2026

quote: open daily from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm ... RM20 for adults

quote: Entry fees are payable by debit or credit cards only, cash is not accepted

quote: tourists only visit between the hours of 9am to 9pm

quote: All visitors are required to wear robes, which are supplied for you

quote: the fees are RM50 for adults... only cards are accepted... book a boat to return via the coastline (RM100 per boat)
